<?php

class Program
{
    public static function main(array $args): void
    {
        $n1 = 0;
        $n2 = 0;
        $n = 0;

        Input::next($n1, $n2);
        Input::next($n);

        $idx = ($n - 1) % 6;
        $neg = false;
        $current = $n1;

        if ($idx >= 3) {
            $neg = true;
            $idx -= 3;
        }

        if ($idx === 1) {
            $current = $n2;
        } elseif ($idx === 2) {
            $current = $n2 - $n1;
        }

        if ($neg) {
            $current *= -1;
        }

        $mod = 1000000007;
        echo (($current % $mod + $mod) % $mod) . PHP_EOL;
    }

    public static function getLastChildGoingHome(array &$inputs, int $candies): int
    {
        for ($i = 0, $length = count($inputs); $i < $length; $i++) {
            $inputs[$i] = $inputs[$i] % $candies === 0
                ? intdiv($inputs[$i], $candies)
                : intdiv($inputs[$i], $candies) + 1;
        }

        $last = 0;
        $lastIdx = 0;

        for ($i = 0, $length = count($inputs); $i < $length; $i++) {
            if ($inputs[$i] >= $last) {
                $last = $inputs[$i];
                $lastIdx = $i;
            }
        }

        return $lastIdx + 1;
    }
}

class Input
{
    private static string $line = '';

    public static function next(&...$values): bool
    {
        $line = fgets(STDIN);

        if ($line === false) {
            foreach ($values as &$value) {
                $value = 0;
            }
            return false;
        }

        self::$line = rtrim($line, "\r\n");

        if ($values !== []) {
            $array = preg_split('/\s+/', trim(self::$line));

            foreach ($values as $index => &$value) {
                $value = isset($array[$index]) ? (int)$array[$index] : 0;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    public static function arrayLong(): array
    {
        if (!self::next()) {
            return [];
        }

        return array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(self::$line)));
    }

    public static function arrayInt(): array
    {
        if (!self::next()) {
            return [];
        }

        return array_map('intval', preg_split('/\s+/', trim(self::$line)));
    }

    public static function getMatrix(int $rows, int $cols): array
    {
        $matrix = array_fill(0, $rows, array_fill(0, $cols, 0));
        $row = 0;

        while ($row < $rows && self::next()) {
            $numbers = array_map(
                'intval',
                preg_split('/\s+/', trim(self::$line))
            );

            foreach ($numbers as $col => $number) {
                if ($col < $cols) {
                    $matrix[$row][$col] = $number;
                }
            }

            $row++;
        }

        return $matrix;
    }

    public static function nextString(string &$value): bool
    {
        if (!self::next()) {
            $value = '';
            return false;
        }

        $value = self::$line;
        return true;
    }
}

Program::main(array_slice($argv, 1));

source_data.prob_desc_description: Jzzhu has invented a kind of sequences, they meet the following property:You are given x and y, please calculate fn modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Output a single integer representing fn modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains two integers x and y (|x|, |y| ≤ 109). The second line contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·109).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first sample, f2 = f1 + f3, 3 = 2 + f3, f3 = 1.In the second sample, f2 =  - 1;  - 1 modulo (109 + 7) equals (109 + 6).
